itinerary:
1. ##Checkin and Pre-Boarding Introductions##

Your Captain will meet you at the La Playa Market on property. They will go over any safety information and go over a quick introductions. At this time, we ask anyone that needs to use the restroom to go ahead. Please keep in mind, there are no restrooms on the cruise.

2. ##Boarding and lifejackets##

Guests will be brought to the boat. Please keep in mind, any passenger 13 years of age or younger is required by US Coast Guard to where the lifejacket regardless of swimming ability. 

3. ##Initial Cruise##

We will then take the lines off the dock and go on our cruise. Your knowledgeable captain will take you so prime spots for the sunset.

4. ##End of cruise and Departing words##

Your captain will then take you and the boat back to the dock for the end of the cruise.
faqs:
##My party are guests of the Kona Kai Resort. Are there any specials or deals we may get for participating in this activity?

Guest of the Kona Kai San Diego? [Click Here To Make your Reservation](https://www.resortkonakai.com/local-experiences/#!/e/san-diego-sunset-bay-cruise-1443f61d) and get up to $100 off your cruise and more.

---

##How can we pre-purchase alcohol and other items?

To pre-purchase additional beverages and items, please [Click here to view our Packages]() and see what we can offer you on this cruise.

*Please note: Alcoholic beverages can only be ordered for groups where all party members are 21+ years old and have a valid ID and only on our sunset Duffy cruise. We can not offer this on our regular power boat sunset cruises.

---

##Can we do 2 hours instead of 1 for this cruise?

Yes, please be sure to contact us before making a reservation. We will submit a request and send you the booking and payment link. Please note that the price will change to reflect this.
